articleTitle: Practical model for electrical properties of highly doped p-type polysilicon
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: This paper describes a new approach to practical modelling of electrical properties of polycrystalline semiconductors. The model combines the electro-physical properties of microcrystalline silicon films with that of monocrystalline silicon so that the former properties are attributed to the grain boundaries regions and the latter to intragrain regions. The model is used to describe the dependence of resistivity (/spl rho/), its temperature coefficient (TC/spl rho/) and gauge factor (G) of highly boron doped polycrystalline silicon, 4.10/sup 25/ to 10/sup 27/ m/sup -3/, on the dopant concentration for different grain sizes, 10/sup -8/ to 10/sup -6/ m. It is shown that at the high doping level /spl rho/ (TC/spl rho/) of polysilicon is higher (lower) than that of monosilicon, being dependent on the average grain size. The gauge factor of polysilicon is lower than that of monosilicon not only because of the "random" orientation of the grains but also because of lower values of gauge factor at the grain boundaries. For lower doping concentration (smaller grain sizes) the TC/spl rho/ of polysilicon becomes negative revealing the higher contribution of grain boundaries.

articleTitle: Invariant zero assignment by squaring down
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A new approach of invariant zero assignment by squaring down of system outputs is proposed. The squaring down matrix partition on two parts is used to implement the approach. One part is chosen from a some left invariant zero assignment condition in a system having unequal numbers of inputs and outputs, the other part is chosen from the some arbitrary invariant zero assignment condition in the squared down system. It is shown that this problem amounts to investigating and solving a set of linear algebraic equations.

articleTitle: Device of information-wave therapy
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The report gives the results of the realization and clinical approbation of autonomous equipment for the non-traumatic intracavity and inner organ influence of electromagnetic radiation with non-thermal intensity. The immediate influence on the pathological foci and reflexogenic zones are points of hollow organs and cavities which demonstrates the high efficiency of the therapeutic process.

articleTitle: Rank and order conditions for local identifiability of linear dynamical models
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The structural identification of linear dynamical models is considered. The necessary and sufficient conditions of identifiability are obtained (rank and order conditions). The procedure of generating the rank matrix is developed. An illustrative example of application of the method is given.

articleTitle: A new approach to the wide band UHF amplifiers with feedback design
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: There was worked out an algorithm of wide band UHF amplifiers with two-port feedback design. The ordered parameters of the active four-port, for a wide band UHF stage with two-ports of combinatory feedback and generalized structure of the active four-port, are represented by the active element at the input and output using phasing-transforming circuits and phasing circuits.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the possibility to use one ultrasonic converter for insonation of objects in the frequency range 0.8-2.7 MHz
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A theoretical evaluation of the possibility of insonation of objects in the frequency range 0.8-2.7 MHz with radiation power density not less than 0.05 W/cm/sup 2/ by use of one piezoceramic plate converter is considered. An analytical model for estimation of insonation intensity for frequencies close to and far from the resonance frequency of the converter with and without a transition medium between the plate and the object is obtained.

articleTitle: Experimental substantiation of the possible mechanism of the laser therapy
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The author considers the possible mechanism of reaction of biological objects on exposure to electromagnetic radiation from quantum sources, including lasers. His hypothesis is based on a study which resulted in the experimental discovery of the torsion component of radiation of quantum sources, and also of the ability of torsion radiation to carry complex information about the structure of spin systems.

articleTitle: Low-frequency section of the phase parametric sonar
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The results of the investigation of the design of the low-frequency channel of the phase parametric sonar are presented. The design of the channel when double conversion of the frequency is realized and when two reference signals are applied are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research of convergence of the Poisson and current continuity equation in heterojunction
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A program for modeling structures, containing both sharp and smooth heterojunctions is created. The program is based on Fermi-Dirac statistics, and takes into account diffusion and drift of charge carriers, as well as thermionic issues at the hetero-interface.

articleTitle: About resonance and non-resonance stimulated transition coefficients
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Resonance and non-resonance stimulated transition coefficients for a system with relaxation are derived. The resonance stimulated transition coefficient was used for calculation of the laser spectrum. The non-resonance stimulated transition coefficients are used for explanation of the observed many-mode spectrum of long lasers.

articleTitle: Phototherapeutic device for osseous muscular tissue therapy
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The results are reported of treatment of in- and out-patients with degenerative dystrophic diseases of joints, ostenialitus of lower extremities, and post-surgery complications. The device was also used on patients with projection pains, trophic ulcers and when stimulating the consolidation of solid tissues during the recovery of closed fracture of long tubular bones with the aim of speeding up the proliferation of soft tissues.

articleTitle: AES and cathodoluminescence of ZnO-Zn phosphor in VFD
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: This report presents AES analysis results of elemental composition of ZnO-Zn phosphor surface in VFD with different luminosity levels.

articleTitle: Scalable wavelet-based coding of color images
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new wavelet-based compression algorithm for still color images especially for low bit rates. The coding algorithm distinguishes itself by a high adaptivity to the image content. It yields an embedded bitstream with the advantage of spatial and quality scalability. The performance of the wavelet codec is demonstrated in comparison with the JPEG standard for different color test images.

articleTitle: Removing input derivatives in generalized state-space systems: a linear algebraic approach
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The problem of lowering the orders of input derivatives in generalized state space systems by generalized state transformations is studied through the language of differential forms. Necessary and sufficient conditions are given for the local existence of such transformation. The sufficiency part of the proof gives a constructive procedure (up to the integration of one-forms) for finding these generalized state transformations. In particular case, these conditions show when it is possible to transform a generalized state space representation into the classical state equations.

articleTitle: Analysis of HF plasma generator power parameters
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The generalized optimisation analysis of HF hybrid plasma generator parameters, HF and HFC devices being particular cases, is given in this paper. The circuit theory method without regard for gas dynamics features was used.

articleTitle: Novosibirsk Joint Research University of Advanced Technologies
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The organization of Novosibirsk Joint Research University (NJRU) of Advanced Technologies created in 1997 is considered. It consists of six educational scientific centers and a center of training and retraining specialists of the highest qualification. Basic themes of research of each center are given.

articleTitle: Monitoring system of power quality factors of common electrical networks
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The computer complex for a measurement of quality of an electrical energy in the correspondence with standard GOST 13109-87 is developed. The complex works on IBM compatible personal computer under operational system WINDOWS 95. The interface part on basis of the microcontroller for deriving and preliminary handling of an information from a line enters into structure of a complex.

articleTitle: Oscillistor sensors with a frequency output based on a silicon structures
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: We present the results of experimental research and elaboration of new sensors with a frequency output, constructed on the principles of functional electronics engineering with the use of the helical instability of electron-hole plasma in silicon. The sensors execute direct conversion of various physical quantities to oscillations frequency and may be used in computer network process engineering.

articleTitle: Technique for searching new operation principles of multifunctional sensors
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: An idea for the design of multifunctional sensors has been suggested. The technique is based on the structure synthesis of substance and energetic transformations of signals with selection of the most rational combinations of physical phenomena and using the knowledge of the material properties where said phenomena manifest themselves. The procedure will be followed by performance evaluation of the obtained measurement principles.

articleTitle: Computer modeling of system of particles [surface dynamics]
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Computer modeling of the dynamics for a two-dimensional system of particles on the basis of a numerical solution of the Newton equations is presented. Model parameters are established, at which the system of particles is in the condition of a firm body, liquid or gas. Particular attention is paid to the behaviour of Si adatoms on a W [110] surface.

articleTitle: Calculation of nematic director deformation in homeotropically-aligned liquid crystal microlens
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Nematic director deformation in a homeotropically-aligned liquid crystal (LC) microlens has been calculated based on the method proposed by Gvozdarev et al. (1998). The calculation results show good agreement with previous experimental data.

articleTitle: The analysis of the transient process in TEM-wave transmission lines on the basis of the model of the communication line piece as an equivalent with lumped parameters with account of the skin effect
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The analysis of the signals propagation of ultrahigh frequencies and transmission of small duration pulses requires increase of the accuracy and expansion of borders of the applicability of existing models. In this paper will be spent the analysis of edges distortions of the pulsing signals, propagating in TEM-wave communication lines, on the basis of the model, in which a piece of line is replaced by a circuit with concentrated elements with account of the skin effect in conductors. The formulas for the transient response of signals, propagating in the loaded lines are received. The formulas, received by the author, supplement the existing Laplace-transformation tables and also specify the cables of determined integrals. By results of the analysis the comparative graphs of the transitive characteristic for a typical communication line with a typical parallel resistor-capacitor load are drawn.

articleTitle: PLL system at influence of a short pulse on oscillatory system of the controlled generator
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In high-speed systems for the measurement of parameters of pulses in the subnanosecond range in a wide range of frequencies, the PLL system is offered for use, in which the time of transients depends on the size of the pulse, influencing the controlled generator.

articleTitle: Device for multiple-wave light diode therapy
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Different colors represent the light energy of different length waves. The energy of photons of the visible spectrum corresponds closely to the energy of physiological transformation of molecules and lies down the conditions to stimulate specific changes in the biological structures. The use of colors when influencing the metaphysical energetic centers (chakre) opens the way to restore the lost balance and in this way can cure the body and the soul.

articleTitle: Sensitivity coefficients for discontinuous many-dimensional dynamic systems with delay time
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A variational method taking account of sensitivity coefficients (components of a gradient from the quality function to the constant parameters) for many dimensional non-linear dynamic systems described by differential equations with a delaying argument, having discontinuities of right members and of phase coordinates, is developed. The solution of the appropriate discontinuous conjugate equations with delay time in the opposite direction is derived.

articleTitle: Rectangular function /spl Pi/(x) and some of its applications for digital circuits design
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A carrying out of the logic operations on pulses and pulse series described by means of rectangular function /spl Pi/(x)(x) is presented in the paper. The logic sum, logic product, logic negation and module 2-sum operations were investigated. The utilising of function /spl Pi/(x)(x) and these operations for mathematical description of binary counters, frequency multiplier and sine wave generator are shown as the examples of application.

articleTitle: About output characteristics calculation of injection laser
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Injection laser theory, based on the effect (gain dependence from energy density) and stationary generation condition for nonlinear model, was developed. A series of measurements (spectrum, output power, threshold current), dependent on various factors, were simulated.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the Greek cross-shaped piezoresistive element
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Theoretical investigations, which have been carried out before, show that Greek cross shaped piezoresistive elements have sensitivity equal to the Wheatstone piezoresistive bridges. For the first time, experimental investigations of Greek cross shaped piezoresistive element, fabricated on a silicon cantilever, are carried out. Load characteristics and temperature dependencies are obtained. The temperature coefficients of the output voltage, surface resistance and piezoresistivity are calculated. The electrical circuit for thermocompensation is suggested and external resistors are selected.

articleTitle: Apparatus for making patterns of metallized strips for microstrip MW devices
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: An apparatus is described which operates on the principle of a coordinatograph. It allows to manufacture with good accuracy microstrip circuits of MW devices without the use of photomasks and photolithography.

articleTitle: Improvement of properties of ballast loadings of a microwave
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The conditions of reduction of losses and improvement of an outcome between inputs of hybrid adders-dividers of capacity of a microwave are found and the appropriate design of the ballast resistor is offered.

articleTitle: Microwave multipliers with synchronization
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In this paper it is reported about the model of transistor microwave doubler. The doubler is based on the input signal synchronizing of double frequency oscillations produced by generator on the collector-base junction of the transistor. The layout and calculations of the doubler's circuit are also represented.

articleTitle: Uniformity cross distribution improvement and angular divergence decrease of powerful wide aperture solid-state medical lasers radiation
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A laser scheme for compensation of the influence of thermal distortions in an active medium is investigated. In a powerful laser with such a scheme a high uniformity of energy cross distribution is achieved, and angular divergence, close to the diffraction limit, at a pulse energy up to 65 J, is obtained.

articleTitle: Comparison of homogeneously- and hybrid-aligned liquid crystal microlenses optical properties
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Optical properties of homogeneously- and hybrid-aligned liquid crystal (LC) microlenses with positive dielectric anisotropy have been researched. Focal length-voltage dependencies are similar for both types of LC-microlens. When voltage is low the microlenses possess focusing optical properties. The focal distance decreases with increasing voltage then becomes minimal and increases. At higher voltage defocusing optical properties are observed. The microlens focal distance decreases approximately asymptotically to a certain value. The numerical aperture decreases with increasing microlens diameter and is smaller for hybrid-aligned LC-microlenses compared to homogeneously-aligned ones.

articleTitle: Frequency transformation for step - irregularpieces of a line of transfer
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)

articleTitle: Detection of anomalous interferences in the case of continuous-discrete time channels of observations with memory with reservation of discrete channels
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of detection of anomalous interferences in the discrete channel of a stochastic system state observation of a stochastic system on the set of continuous and discrete observations with memory in the case of reservation of discrete channels.

articleTitle: A study of interface states of directly bonded silicon-on-insulator (SOI) structures
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In this paper, experimental data on the temperature-dependent transient photoconductivity obtained on bonded SOI structures are presented. It is shown that, during the bonding process at the interface of the sample, electrically active states appear. The values of activation energies and capture cross-sections of charge carriers at the interface are similar to those at the interface of silicon and thermal oxide.

articleTitle: Transition sheath "plasma-wall"
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The boundary kinetic problem is considered for the "plasma-wall" transition sheath in the case that the boundary conditions for the plasma ion component at the "plasma-sheath" boundary has a shift in velocity. The appropriate boundary problem has been solved in a general form. The expression for the right hand side of the Poisson equation was obtained for the case where the boundary conditions for the distribution function (DF) of plasma components have the form of Maxwellian functions. Numerical investigations have been carried out of electrostatic potential over a wide range of velocities of the plasma ion component. The results obtained can serve as a background for constructing a theory of the transition sheath in the absence of a magnetic field.

articleTitle: Analysis of destructive physicochemical processes in optical media of liquid crystal displays
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The destructive physicochemical processes of electrolysis and degradation of electroconductivity in optical media of the smectic A liquid crystal displays (LCDs) are studied. The causes and mechanism of processes are discussed. The received results are important both for the driving optimisation and for increase of field controlled light scattering LCD reliability.

articleTitle: Microstructure and electrophysical properties of Ca,Cu enriched Bi-2223 HTSC ceramics
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The effect of excess of Ca and Cu on superconducting and electrophysical properties of Bi-2223 ceramics was investigated. It was found that a certain excess of Ca and Cu in the nominal composition with relation to the stoichiometric one improves the superconductive properties of the ceramics which results from the developing of dense net of intergranular contacts during formation of ceramics microstructure.

articleTitle: Active identification of stochastic dynamic systems
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: It is necessary to know the covariance matrices of measurement noise and dynamic system noise, state and control matrices in order to estimate the optimal state vector. In this paper, algorithmic aspects of linear dynamic system active identification for optimal solution of the Kalman filter problem are considered. It is proposed to solve the input design task by using an input signal autocorrelation function in the time domain and an input signal spectral density in the frequency domain.

articleTitle: Chemisorption getter pump
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: It is possible to maintain high vacuum in small volume devices during long term service using getter pumps connected to the devices. There is no magnetic system in the pump. Electrical energy is not needed when the pump is in operation. The micropumps work on the principle of chemisorption of residual chemically active gases. Regimes of degassing and pore titanium gas-adsorber activation were determined.

articleTitle: Methods of control of technological process of an electronic irradiation of power semiconductor devices (PSD)
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The technological process of electronic irradiation is applied in batch production of power semiconductor devices (PSDs) for improving their dynamic characteristics. As the capacities of converters have been growing and because of the necessity to use PSD at parallel and series connections, PSDs should have values of on-state voltage (U/sub tm/) and reverse recovery charge (Q/sub rr/) that differ from each other by the preset value but no more. The authors develop methods of regulation of the values of Q/sub rr/ and U/sub tm/ of semiconductor devices with preset precision.

articleTitle: The computerized complex of AFC measurement of dielectric media in the UHF range
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The automation complex permits one to measure the dielectric properties of materials in the UHF range (37...150 MHz). The opportunity of the complex application for the research of core and slime samples of rock, drilling muds, oil, model water solutions is shown.

articleTitle: Measuring error degradation of phase difference of microwave signals
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The method of minimization of an error of measurement of the difference of phases of microwave signals is considered, in which the transformation of signals downwards is carried out on frequency, and measurement of a difference of phases of the signals of intermediate frequency is made. The method allows one to remove errors caused by the un-identity of phase-frequency and amplitude-frequency characteristics of the parallel channels of a meter, at simultaneous expansion of a range of measured meanings of a difference of phases.

articleTitle: The electrodischarged-crystallized method of solid body surface research
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)

articleTitle: Design of intellectual systems with uncertain logic of control
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Soft control on the basis of analysis of textual descriptions and enquiries of object control are considered. A new concept of soft control is proposed. A good agreement between the proposed concept and the classic version of uncertain control is shown. The advantages of a combination of the classic and proposed methods are shown.

articleTitle: Dynamic control of high-current ion-electron sources with micro-second length
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In ion-electron sources, based on vacuum-arc generators, electrical parameters of plasma generators are related to the shape of the plasma flow and the current density distribution at the target. Plasma-gas dynamic control is performed through formation of the plasma front local parameters. The device efficiency is raised without affecting the electrical parameters.

articleTitle: Variants of algorithms of bridge circuits synthesis for control-measuring devices
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The synthesis algorithm of a four-arms bridge circuit with the feed by impulses of complicated form and with homogeneous reactive elements in the objects of measurement is considered. The example of synthesis of a bridge circuit is given.

articleTitle: Measuring expert system for estimating of technical condition of internal-combustion engine
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The measuring expert system of an internal-combustion engine (ICE) is considered. The database is formed on the basis of the measured information from sensors (of pressure in the chamber combustions and in the fuel-line, angular motion etc.). The base of knowledge in the given subject domain on classification of a condition of the engine is created. The system gives the logic circuit of a technological chain of the technical condition examination of internal-combustion engines.

articleTitle: Parameter design algorithm for multivariable dynamic systems
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The paper is devoted to a solution of the parameter design problem for linear multivariable deterministic and stochastic systems. Parameter design is formulated as a nonlinear optimization problem on a set of solutions of the Lyapunov matrix algebraic equation. The possibility of application of gradient optimization methods for the determination of the best value of the adjusted parameters vector is considered. Formulae for evaluation of the gradient of the minimized function are derived. As an example, the parameter design problem of aircraft longitudinal motion is considered. Calculation and simulation results are given. The results should be useful for computer aided design control systems of complex technical objects.

articleTitle: A stable-equilibrium control and decision making in complicated structure systems under conflict and uncertainty
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A model of complicated control and decision making systems containing several subsystems under conflict interactions is considered. The efficiency of each subsystem is evaluated by a vector criterion. Convex closed cones are used for a preference definition of each subsystem. The concept of /spl epsiv/-stable generalized /spl delta/-equilibrium is formulated.

articleTitle: Dynamic processes in the technology of film formation for optoelectronic elements
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: On a basis of notions of the jet nature of vapour exhaust during thermal vacuum evaporation of materials, a link has been established between geometrical and parameter values of an exhaust flow with gas phase reactions and the laws of evaporation. Results are presented for Ti film deposition on NaNbO/sub 3/.

articleTitle: Recurrent modeling and processing of signals based on Gibbs model
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: An application of Gibbs distribution to stochastic sequences description and interpolation estimating is considered. The opportunity of sequences generation and Bayes processing procedures recurrent realization is established on the basis of induced potentials preliminary calculation. Examples are given.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of physical processes in Josephson junction
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The method of simulation investigates the solution of differential equations for differences of phases /spl phi/ of wave functions of coupled electrons on bath sides of Josephson junction.

articleTitle: Techniques of polihedral set in discrete control tasks by finite state
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The application of polyhedral set technology to the task of optimal in high-performance control by discrete objects is discussed. The control determination is reduced to decision of linear programming tasks class. The control precision analysis method of control object movement on conditions of its parametric indeterminacy is suggested.

articleTitle: The influence of the inductance on the voltage-current characteristic and on low frequency performance of DC SQUIDs
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the detailed study of the way by which the inductance of the two junction interferometer (DC SQUID) influences its voltage current characteristic and the low frequency current noise. A rigorous mathematical procedure for the calculation of the averaged voltage across the symmetrical DC SQUID is developed for the nonzero values of the interferometer loop inductance L. The L-dependent part of the voltage noise which comes from the low frequency fluctuations of the junctions' critical current is also found. The obtained results can be used for the correct evaluation of the important SQUID characteristics and for the development of the effective techniques for the electronic cancellation of the low frequency fluctuations in practical devices.

articleTitle: Some results of research work in the field of the design of the phase parametric sonar systems
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Some results of research work in the field of designing the phase parametric sonar systems are presented. The novelty of the sonar consists in the use of additional information of the searched objects due to the measuring the phase shift of biharmonic echo signals emitted by a parametric antenna which is fed by pulsed signals with amplitude modulation.

articleTitle: Spatial structure of carbon nanotubes produced in arc discharge
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: High-resolution transmission electron microscopic investigation of carbon nanoparticles produced in the arc discharge was carried out. A carbon deposit formed on the negative electrode in the condition of high temperature and electric field consists of multiwall chiral nanotubes. Condensation of carbon vapors leads to the synthesis of single-wall nanotubes having singular structure mainly.

articleTitle: Autonomous system of electrosupply with a direct current link
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)

articleTitle: A method for constructing an image of an object by means of the synthesized aperture using Doppler signal
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In this paper a method for constructing an image of an object by means of the synthesized antenna aperture using Doppler signal reflected by this object is proposed. This method is based on the well-known property of the synthesized aperture to focus on a certain range. Cartograms of the objects reconstructed using Doppler signal are presented.

articleTitle: Measurement of electrophysical parameters of piezoceramic by the acousticthermooptical method
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Same results theoretical and experimental studies possible measurements of electrophysical parameters of piezoceramic by the acousticthermooptical method are discussed.

articleTitle: Property investigation of the REM-Co and REM-Fe-B alloy powders obtained by means of hydrogenous embrittlement and the permanent magnets on their basis
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Different in chemical composition alloy Sm-Fe-Cu-Zr-Co, Sm-Gd-Er-Co-Fe-Cu-Zr and Nd-Fe-Tb-B, Nd-Fe-Tb-Co-B ingots were dispersed by combination of hydrogenous embrittlement and grind in ball-vibrational mill as well as by breaking in highly intense disintegrator. It is shown that the hydrogenons embrittlement process can be controlled and there exists a principle ability to obtain powders with a specified granulometric composition. The powder obtained by hydrogenous embrittlement was compacted and fritted according to a certain program. The magnets obtained in such a way have more high properties than the magnets obtained by usual vibrational grinding.

articleTitle: New physical effects in MOS-structures
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In inversion layers on the surface of Si in MOS-structures in presence of the magnetic field parallel to the layer, the asymmetry of interactions of electrons with elementary excitations (photons, acoustic phonons, etc.) propagating in mutually opposite directions appears. The consequence of this asymmetry is that any isotropic perturbation of the electron system leads to emergence of electromotive force, which is the basis of a new class of electron transport phenomena.

articleTitle: Bottom sediment's identification as an inverse problem of echo-sounding
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Methods available for recognition of the structure and for measuring the width of the sediment layers of the sea bottom using echo-sounders are discussed considering in particular the inverse problem and consideration of echo signals.

articleTitle: A design technique for high Q-factor SI filters
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A problem of SI realisation of a high quality (Q) factor biquadratic filter is considered with emphasis on the signal-dependent clock feedthrough (SDCF) influence upon sensitivities of filter design parameters. The CMOS digital gate array-based implementation of medium Q-factor biquadratic filter resulted in a high random deviation of Q-factor value. An explanation of the phenomenon considered has been found by means of biquadratic filter model analysis taking into account the SDCF effect. It has been shown that a significant reduction of Q-factor sensitivities is possible to achieve through the use of an optimised DC-transfer-function voltage-to-current converter (VCC). A new S/sup 2/I memory cell utilising this VCC has been proposed and its advantage compared to the current state-of-the-art S/sup 2/I memory cell demonstrated.

articleTitle: Determination of parameters in semiconductors using the Shubnikov-de Haas effect
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The oscillations of reflection and transmission coefficients of the probing laser radiation (Shubnikov-de Haas (SdH) effect) in low-dimensional GaAs/AlGaAs structures, containing quantum wells, and in degenerate n-InSb at low temperatures (/spl sim/2 K) were investigated. The possibility of contactless determination of the transport parameters in semiconductors, based on the observations of SdH oscillations at liquid nitrogen temperature, is discussed.

articleTitle: Power amplifier for high frequency CO/sub 2/-laser stimulation
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: We give the results of construction of the double-ended power amplifier on the generator tetrodes, which is used for the high frequency CO/sub 2/-laser stimulation. The stimulation power approaches 3 kW in pulse and 500 W in the continuous mode, with the operation frequency of 110 MHz. A special attention is given to the effect of interaction of the active elements of the double-ended amplifier with the reflecting load, and to the choice of their operation mode.

articleTitle: Curved vibrators with increased gain
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Curved S, V, N-shaped vibrators and "seagull"-shaped vibrators are described. These vibrators have raised gain in comparison with linear vibrators. The experimental and calculated radiation patterns of such vibrators are presented.

articleTitle: Sensor switch application in electric power saving systems
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: New methods of sensor switch application in adjusting systems for electric power supplies are considered. Structural and fundamental circuits of separate device units providing electric power saving and their control by a program are discussed.

articleTitle: Mathematical models of wave processes in cable lines 6-10 kW with realization of a pulse method of location of inhomogeneity and defects
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Accounts of primary and wave parameters of cables with sectional core, based on a method of Sidelnikov, giving good convergence with experiment, are presented. The complex of programs, allowing to make a detailed research reflectogram of defects and inhomogeneity in cable lines in view of frequency dependencies of parameters, is developed. Experimental measurements on samples of cables and muftis are made.

articleTitle: Computer biofeedback: trends of development
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Computer biofeedback development during the last 10 years is reviewed. Areas considered include: digital signal processors, application development toolkits, multimedia, behavioral medicine applications for pathological addictions, attention and memory disturbances, depressions etc. Special attention is given to the new biofeedback branch that is computer treating and disease-preventing games.

articleTitle: Maintenance of uniform distribution of temperature on a surface of the resistor HIS
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The procedure of a finding the temperature in any point of the thin-film resistor is considered. The conditions of reduction of thermal loading of rectangular resistors HIS are found.

articleTitle: The new approach to luminescence use in photochromic materials for two-photon optical memory
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Photochromic materials with implanted dyes with a luminescence spectrum maximum coincident with the absorption spectrum of the written photochrome form are proposed for use in optical memory devices.

articleTitle: Waveguide filters on resonance discontinuities
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In this paper waveguide filters are described in which resonant elements are used in the capacity of reactive irregularities. The filters have asymmetrical frequency performance. Calculation expressions and frequency performance for two types of filters for different disposition of passband and stopband are given.

articleTitle: Observation of Coulomb blockade in structures created by the method of SECO (step edge cut off)
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: For observation of the Coulomb blockade, SECO-structures with self-aligned gates with island size of 170/spl times/170/spl times/12 nm on Ti/Si/sub 3/N/sub 4/ were fabricated. On these structures, single-electron current oscillations from gate voltage were observed at a temperature of 4.2 K. The magnitude of the Coulomb gap was 6 mV.

articleTitle: The influence of boundary conditions and alignment layers on the field controlled light scattering in S/sub A/ phase liquid crystal displays
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: In the present paper it is shown that the impact of electric field with optimum amplitude-frequency parameters is sufficient to induce formation of S/sub A/ liquid crystal (LC) basic optical states. There are stable focal (FC) conic light scattering structures and stable homeotropic (HT) light transmission structures of the S/sub A/ LC. The threshold of the electrohydrodynamic (EHD) instability and the optical losses of liquid crystal display (LCD) are decreased by the absence of the alignment layers. At the same time LCD design and technology is essentially simplified.

articleTitle: The non-traditional approach to designing multipliers of frequency parallel type
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The problem of maintenance of stability of the parallel multiplier of frequency (MF) with the help of of directed filters on connected smooth inhomogeneous transmission lines (CSITL) is decided. For want of it parasitic peak modulation on an input of the multiplier completely is eliminated. Problems of the coordination of the diode with the generator and load also are considered. As a broadband agreeing circuit the sequential single irregular transmission line (ITL) with the smooth law of a modification of a wave drag is used. The topology of the doubler in microstrip performance is designed.

articleTitle: Local-optimum control of system with variable structure
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Consider problem of system governing with the variable structure by means of local-optimum control. As an example is consider problem to stabilizations a velocity of electroengine of direct current with the width-pulse modulator.

articleTitle: Synthesis and structure of oxygenated fullerene film
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The conductive properties of C/sub 60/ films annealed in oxygen are different from unannealed samples. The films turn X-ray amorphous and show semiconducting behavior. The present work is devoted to a study of the role of oxygen in the oxidation process of C/sub 60/ films on the basis of a structure investigation. The fullerene films were obtained by gas-phase deposition in dry argon at low pressure. The films were annealed in air for 30 minutes at temperatures of 330-390 /spl deg/C. Reflection IR spectra were obtained for films on silicon substrates.

articleTitle: Kinetic theory of electrostatic transition layer "plasma-wall"
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A (1D,3V) electrostatic collisionless kinetic layer model for a plasma in contact with a material surface is developed. Distribution functions (DF) of plasma components in the plasma-wall transition layer are obtained on the basis of an analysis appropriate to the boundary kinetic problem. Correct boundary conditions and equations for calculation of the Bohm potential are deduced which ensure a continuous interface of the quasi-neutral plasma with a transition layer.

articleTitle: Synthesis and modeling of operatively rebuilding networks of converters
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The method of synthesis of the circuits of independent inverters using tensor transformation of coordinates for the generation of variants of the circuit decisions is offered. On the basis of the specified method the concept of operatively rebuilding converter networks (ORCN) is formulated. The model of a network constructed on the basis of current inverters is developed. The results of research are given.

articleTitle: Non-linear dynamics of phase synchronization systems including frequency conversion devices
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A number of specific aspects is discussed concerning the performance of frequency conversion PLL systems in the UHF range. False lock-in probability at multiple frequencies due to wideband noise sources has been analyzed for pulse PLLs with varying division ratio dividers (VDRD). Recommendations have been obtained on the false lock-in elimination. A series of time delay PLL system models has been investigated. It has proved to be advisable in engineering calculations to apply the models using the first members of the ideal delay operator of Pade functions expansion and the small parameter approach. The results of theoretical investigations were practically used in time interval generators and UHF synthesizer developments.

articleTitle: Research of an infrared absorption and conductivity of C/sub 60/:I/sub 2/ film
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The method of IR spectroscopy have been used for research in C/sub 60/:I/sub 2/ film synthesized by a gas-phase deposition as joint evaporation fullerene and iodine. The polymerization capability of fullerene is shown to take place on interaction fullerene with iodine. The electro-physical characteristics of obtained films are measured. Specific resistance of C/sub 60/I/sub 1.6/ samples has been shown to slightly depend on temperature in range 78-295 K and to be 10/sup 2/ /spl Omega/-cm at 295 K.

articleTitle: Generalized moving extrapolation of stochastic systems in the case of continuous and discrete time channels of observations with the fixed memory
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of state vector moving extrapolation of a continuous time stochastic system simultaneously in an arbitrary number of future time moments on realization processes in the case of both continuous and discrete time channels. It is found that the solution depends on both the current values and the former values of the state vector.

articleTitle: Technological vacuum-arc sources of plasma for electronics industry
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The physical features and main formation laws of various geometry plasma streams, generated by technological vacuum-arc plasma sources are presented. Applications to plasma deposition in the electronics industry are described briefly.

articleTitle: About energy balance of the hollow cathode arc
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The energy analysis of near-cathode processes allows one to make qualitative conclusions about vacuum arc stability and the influence of basic parameters on the arc state. Decrease of voltage below /spl phi//sub k/* under fixed current density will lead to cathode overheating, reverse electron current and conversion of the diffusion cathode spot to a contra-reactionary one. The non-monotonous character of the current density distribution along the cylindrical hollow cathode length has been confirmed by analysis of the energy processes in the hollow cathode.

articleTitle: The bridge circuits with equilibration by adjustable resistors
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The outcome of research on bridge circuits with equilibration by adjustable resistors is considered for unlimited, in principle, number of elements in the objects of measurement. For the construction of such bridges, special quadrupoles are used. Impulses of complicated form are applied for feeding the bridges.

articleTitle: The oscillatory phenomena in modeling by analytical signal for the processes with the rectangular envelope
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The defect of presentation of high frequency pulse with rectangular envelope by analytical signal (AS) is researched. It is shown, that AS leads to paradoxical results, which do not have physical base. The way of obtaining of complex signal, providing determination of physical envelope and phase of radiosignal, is designed.

articleTitle: Method of an engineering regularization of sliding modes in multi-input nonlinear systems with two-position control law
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The author presents a method for frequency stabilization of multi-dimensional real sliding modes in automatic control systems for nonlinear time-varying dynamic objects with a two-position control law using feedback with special linear filters.

articleTitle: A non-linear discrete-time adaptive control algorithm for time-varying plans
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: An adaptive discrete-time system for dynamic characteristics stabilization is considered. The regulator construction is based on a localization method. The influence of a discretization step and the initial significance of state coordinates to the processes in the system are discussed. A sequence of calculations for the regulator parameters is proposed.

articleTitle: Positive resists for electron-beam and X-ray lithography
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: For the first time the method of chemical modification of polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) as a positive radiation resist which allows 2-3 fold increase of PMMA sensitivity to radiation without the lost of its high resolution has been proposed. Organohydridedisilanes (DS) have been used as modificators of the polymer. These modificators include Si-Si bonds weaker than C-C bonds which make a contribution to the increase of efficiency of the polymer chain scissions upon irradiation. Lines of 0.14 /spl mu/m width were produced in the 0.41 /spl mu/m thick PMMA films by electron-beam lithography. Based on the PMMA copolymers modified by DS two resists of 5-8 times higher sensitivity than PMMA and similar contrast have been developed.

articleTitle: Pico-microammeter
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The paper describes a low-profile device with two-batteries feeding. The log transformation range is 10/sup -12/-10/sup -6/ A. The current measurement error for 1 /spl mu/A does not exceed 1,5%, 10/sup -12/.

articleTitle: Finite observer of objects' state with delay time
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A scheme of finite observation of linear stationary control objects' state with delay time at channels of measurement is suggested.

articleTitle: The low-waste-products-of electroless nickel deposition brocess in the elektronic engineering
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)

articleTitle: About a possibility of brightness magnification of gas discharge indicated panels
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The results are presented of research on the possibility of increasing the light efficiency of radiation and brightness GDIP of a direct current at the expense of transition from weak current long impulsed anomalous smoulder discharge to high-current short impulse (tens and hundreds ns) discharge in xenon. Favorable conditions for development of high-current avalanches and generation of a continuum of a radiation are created. It is established, that for want of diminution of voltage pulse duration from 6 up to 03 mcs for want of constant average current and impulse voltage the brightness of a cell GDIP will increase 2.5-3 times.

articleTitle: Peculiarity of some nonperiodical signals Fourier transform definition
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The special features of Fourier transform practical definition of nonperiodical signals independent of frequency band are considered. For Fourier transform definition of such signals represented by discrete samples, preliminary restoration of continuous signals by interpolation of the third or higher degrees Lagrange interpolational splines is described. With an example of interpolation polynomial Lagrange of the third degree, formulas for Fourier transform definition of a signal on a discrete grid of frequencies are shown. The errors of Fourier transform definition of an exponential signal represented by Lagrange interpolational splines of the second and higher degree are analyzed.

articleTitle: Scattering of parametric array signals by spherical unregularities
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Different objects, situated in water medium, can be obtained in the region of formation of radiation of parametric array. For example, air bubbles, bioobjects, singular fishes, fish accumulations etc. These objects, being present in the region of interaction of primary waves, may put distortions and changes in the field, that is forming, scattering sound energy. Because of that it is necessary to consider their possible influence. In the given issue this problem is solved in the next formulation: scattering objects are modeling as absolutely hard spheres, re-radiating signals of parametric array to the space angle.

articleTitle: Structure of chemical bonding in polymerized fullerene C/sub 60/
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Thermal treatment of fullerene C/sub 60/ under high vacuum leads to the formation of an X-ray amorphous polymer of fullerene. This compound has a semiconductor-type conductivity. The electronic structure of the polymerized fullerene is studied by X-ray emission spectroscopy and quantum-chemical methods. The upper occupied molecular orbital of the trimer (C/sub 60/)3 is shown to be localized on its central C/sub 60/ fragment which explains some of the electrophysical properties of the polymeric chains (C/sub 60/)n.

articleTitle: Calculations of electrical characteristics of resonant tunneling structures
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Since Tsu and Esaki (1973) first proposed the resonant tunneling diode (RTD), RTDs have been widely investigated both, theoretically and experimentally, because of their physical properties and potential for high-speed device applications. Resonant tunneling is a strictly quantum phenomenon in which charged carriers tunnel between the two electrodes of a double-barrier heterostructure through the quantized quasibound state of a potential well. In this report, we have performed numerical calculations of the current-voltage characteristics for the case of a GaAs-AlAs RTD under hydrostatic pressure. Our calculation is based on the envelope-function approximation.

articleTitle: /spl beta/- and /spl gamma/-radiation detectors based on GaAs with deep centres
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Single and multi-element detectors for /spl gamma/-radiation (E/sub /spl gamma//>0.2 MeV) detection have been developed and investigated. Experimental results are in good agreement with calculation due to the high registration efficiency of the detector structure.

articleTitle: Spectral representation of linear operators in the Hilbert space
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Representing solution methods of nonlinear operator equations in system theory requires the inclusion of notions and methods of functional analysis. An example is given of statements of linear system theory as they relate to mathematical notions of functional analysis.

articleTitle: Microstrip technique for investigation of dielectric characteristics of liquid crystals in SHF range
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The microstrip sensors for studying dielectric properties of liquid crystals (LQ) in SHF range are developed. The behavior of the SHF permittivity of a nematic liquid crystal 5CB in external electrical and magnetic fields is studied. The minimum of dielectric losses in LQ is found to be when the orientation of long axes of molecules are parallel to the direction of SHF electrical field. The permittivity dispersion for the liquid crystal 5CB in solid, nematic and isotropic phases is investigated. The dielectric spectra revealed the resonant features concerned with the conformational molecular vibrations.

articleTitle: Temperature possibilities of GaAs membrane pressure sensor
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Results have been given of a calculation and of an experimental study of the GaAs membrane pressure sensor (MPS) characteristics. The analysis of our results shows that GaAs MPS have the sensitivity and output signal only twice smaller than analogous Si MPS with diffusion tensoresistors and closely spaced characteristics for Si MPS with polycrystalline thermoresistors.

articleTitle: Design of robust discrete-time control systems
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The problem of forming desired output transients for discrete time system is discussed under assumption of incomplete information about varying parameters of the system and unknown external disturbances. The main result of the paper is the procedure to analyse of fast and slow motions in the discrete-time control system with small parameter.

articleTitle: Computational schemes of finite element modelling of three-dimensional electromagnetic fields, excited by harmonic current in circular loop
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The mathematical modeling of three-dimensional electromagnetic fields excited by a harmonic current in a circular loop is a theoretical basis for the creation of new mineral prospecting technologies. For such problems solving, the technique of finite-element modeling, based on axisymmetrical field part selection, is offered. The developed technique was applied to the solution of logging and aerial prospecting problems. An example is given of field properties calculation in the problem of profiling above a vertical three-dimensional high-resistance object.

articleTitle: Sea surface statistics measurement by means of polyharmonic echo-signals processing
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: It is shown that acoustic method of sea surface statistics' measurement may be successfully realized on the base of polyharmonic signals emitting and polyharmonic echo-signals processing.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic forming of thin piezoceramic discs
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Consideration is being given to the main physical and engineering elements of ultrasonic forming of thin discs made from piezoceramic materials of lead zirconate titanate (PZT).

articleTitle: Influence of parameters of ambient air on resistance of fullerene C/sub 60/ films [and sensor application]
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: We present some results relating to the influence of ambient air parameters (temperature, humidity, pressure) on the resistance of two sorts of fullerene films (non-annealed and thermal annealed) in the temperature range 330-390/spl deg/C. Fullerene films were obtained by gas-phase deposition on sapphire substrate. The results have shown that the resistance of the films depends strongly on ambient air parameters. This allows fullerene films to be used as sensitive materials for temperature, humidity, pressure sensor devices.

articleTitle: An analog-digital CMOS semicustom array for high-performance mixed-mode ASICs
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A standard-digital-CMOS-process-compatible analog-digital CMOS semicustom array architecture is presented. The array is suitable for high-performance SC circuit design, though, other circuit techniques such as SI and continuous-time analog signal processing are possible. Main cells of an analog standard cells library are presented as well as experimental results of testing some SC systems such as the 5-th order elliptic SC low-pass filter and the 10-bit DAC are discussed.

articleTitle: Criterion of intrinsic charge bistability appearance in double-barrier resonant-tunneling structures
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The model of intrinsic charge bistability in double-barrier resonant-tunneling structure was modified taking into account an approximate energy dependence of the barrier transmission coefficient and a form of the charge distribution in the quantum well. A criterion of bistability appearance in symmetric structures was obtained and extended to structures with many-valley electron tunneling transport.

articleTitle: The power amplifier for TV transmitter
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The amplifier with the output power of 100 Wt, adjusted on any VHF TV channels is described. It consist of two 75 Wt amplifiers and a block of dividing and adding of power and ensuring the separate amplification of the image and sound signals with their following adding on filter-plexer including in each of 75 Wt amplifiers.

articleTitle: Parameters of the active four-port for a wide band UHF amplifier with a combinatory feedback
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: There are estimated the necessary parameters of the active four-port for a wide band UHF amplifier with the ordered structure of feedback and the input and output coupling gain.

articleTitle: Sensors based on plant seed
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The advantages of using plant fruit as multifunctional sensors of measuring devices are presented. The design of such sensors, for the measurement of temperature and humidity, is described.

articleTitle: The integrated pressure sensor with AlGaAs-baroresistors
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: A pressure sensor with omnidirectional pressure sensitive AlGaAs-film resistors incorporated in the Wheatstone bridge is described.

articleTitle: Semiconductor spectrum analyzer for monochromatic radiation
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The paper presents a semiconductor spectrum analyzer (SCSA) operating on the principle of nonlinear spin resonance excited in n-InSb due to stimulated combinational light scattering with signal amplification.

articleTitle: The source of high-voltage short pulses for control of electro-optic modulator
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: We give the results of the development of the high-voltage periodical pulse source used for the control of the electro-optical laser emission modulator (EOM). The source produces pulses with an amplitude of 1.2 kV on the EOM capacitor, and with a pulse duration of 4 ns at the level 0.9 and adjusting repetition frequency.

articleTitle: The cosmic background radiation and low-frequency fluctuation
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The paper outlines new developments on nonlinear coupling between temperature and quantum number of the states. The fluctuations of the temperature in the cosmic space is the reason for the excess (or 1/f) noise.

articleTitle: Silicon thermoelectrical sensors for the heat flow study
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The authors study a silicon thermoelectric sensor for small radiant heat flow measurement in heat-protection systems studies. The sensitivity of the sensor is of the order of 2.2+15.4/spl middot/10/sup -6/ V/spl middot/m/sup 2//Vt. The output signal has linear character.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of potential distribution on axis of electron-optical converter
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: An analytical expression for calculation of the potential distribution on the axis of an electron-optical converter is derived. The expression differs from that obtained earlier (Lisitsyna et al., 1985) by the numerical factor in the exponent. Calculations based on this expression and those from the finite difference method are different within 3%.

articleTitle: Two-photon excitation of phthalocyanine
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: The spectra of two-photon excited luminescence (TPEL) of phthalocyanine solutions in ethanol are obtained. The two-photon nature of TPEL is confirmed by close to square-law dependence luminescence versus intensity of excitation.

articleTitle: The analysis of development of engineering hardware for reflexotherapy
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)

articleTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
publicationTitle: 1998 4th International Conference on Actual Problems of Electronic Instrument Engineering Proceedings. APEIE-98 (Cat. No.98EX179)
abstract: Presents the title page of the proceedings record.
